class.name: ChorusEmbeddingRequest
class.description: Input for [method GodotChorus.embed] or [method GodotChorus.embed_batch]. Embeddings do not read or modify conversation history. A nonempty [member ChorusInferenceRequest.session] reserves that session until the terminal signal is delivered. Check [method GodotChorus.supports_embeddings] after loading the model.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates an embedding request for [param content]. Leave [param session] empty for stateless work. This only creates the resource; submit it with [method GodotChorus.embed].
